تصلح لالتقاء الاحبه والاجتماعات العائليه بل وفيها مواقع متخصصه للشوي وللاحتفالات الترفيهيه .

للحديقه مواقف فسيحه وكبيره ولكن للاسف لا تغطي الكم الهائل من مرتاديها ومحبيها ونقترح عمل مواقف ارضيه ولو برسوم رمزيه .
وبشكل عام ننصح بزيارة الحديقه وبشده فهي الخيار الاجمل والاسعد حالها كحال بقية حدائق دبي الجميله الرائعه..
نشكر القائمين عليها متمنيين لهم دوام التقدم والازدهار وسننتظر ما يستحد لرفع التقييم للدرجه التاليه.
textTranslated:
A beautiful, spacious, and clear park with a prime location overlooking Dubai Creek.

It's perfect for gatherings with loved ones and families, and even has designated areas for barbecues and recreational celebrations.

However, it suffers from a shortage of restrooms, their small size, poor cleanliness, and a lack of the required quality. It also needs more attention in maintaining its green spaces, lush trees, and paved paths.

The park has ample parking, but unfortunately, it doesn't accommodate the large number of visitors. We suggest adding underground parking, even for a nominal fee.

Overall, we highly recommend visiting the park; it's the most beautiful and enjoyable choice, like all the other wonderful parks in Dubai. We thank those in charge and wish them continued progress and prosperity. We look forward to further developments to raise the rating to the next level.

Creek Park - A Vibrant Park with a Few Crowding Issues

Creek Park in Dubai is undoubtedly one of the best parks in town, offering a wide range of amenities and attractions for visitors of all ages. However, its popularity can lead to large crowds, especially on weekends. To fully enjoy your visit, it's recommended to arrive early and secure a spot.

The park provides dedicated barbecue spots, both for groups and individuals. While this is a fantastic feature, the high volume of visitors often results in sharing these areas with other groups or families. This can diminish the tranquility of the experience, as the park tends to get quite busy. Managing the massive weekend crowds is a challenge for the park, and this is its main drawback.

Despite the crowd, Creek Park boasts an expansive and well-maintained landscape. Every corner of the park is beautifully designed, providing a visually pleasing environment. There is ample parking available outside the park, making it convenient for visitors to access.

Upon entering, the park offers various amenities, including cafeterias, restaurants, and a shop for kids' accessories. The park features multiple entry gates, ensuring easy access from different directions. Inside, you'll find a sprawling playground for kids, a cycling track, seating areas with scenic creek views, outdoor gaming facilities, clean toilets, and even a prayer room. These amenities contribute to a well-rounded park experience.

Considering the park's overall offerings, I would rate Creek Park with four stars. While the crowding issue can affect the peacefulness of the visit, the park's expansive layout and diverse amenities make it a worthwhile destination. Whether you're looking for family-friendly activities or simply a pleasant outdoor setting, Creek Park is a fantastic choice.

name: shoeb arif
text:
5point Review
Activity Duration: Picnic, Barbecue, or just lie around. From 1 hour to half a day.
Ratings: 7/10 (Tourists can club this park with Dolphinarium)

UAE is a desert country, but you have to drive away from the cities to actually see the desert. Amidst the never-ending puzzle of zigzagging roads and towering skyscrapers, you can find some beautiful (and mostly huge) public parks, constructed by Dubai Parks Authorities. A big thumbs up to the Government for first conceptualizing and developing these parks and then maintaining them in these harsh climates in an immaculate manner. Now here are my 5-Pointers on some of the best Dubai parks. Dubai might not have a Central Park like New York, but there are many alternatives in different areas for some fun-filled picnics. (These parks might not be big enough attractions for tourists, but they are sure shot life savers for the residents)
1. The Good: Well-maintained grassy lawns. Tick. The breeze from Creek. Tick. Walk along the sea. Tick. Children's play area. Tick. Barbecue. Tick. Attraction=Dolphinarium. Tick. Some cute bicycles and buggies to ride around the park. Tick
2. The Not-So-Good: Some entry points are closed. And walking from one gate to another is really a hassle. Plus NOL card top ups not available on all gates. Need to address this issue as it is very very inconvenient.
3. The WoW factor: Huge area. Well Maintained. Lots of play areas for kids. Creek view is a plus.
4. Money Matters: 5 AED per person. Well worth it.
5. The 5-point Experience: Dubai Park Authorities needs to be given big kudos for creating such places for the common public. You never run out of options for weekend outings in Dubai and this park is one such place. Huge place with a lot of options. We hired the small family vehicle (buggy that works like a bicycle) to drive around the park and that was super fun.
My Verdict: Just come here and have fun.

Die Anlage ist sehr weitläufig, gepflegt und bietet viele schattige Plätze, große Wiesen, Spielplätze für Kinder und tolle Wege entlang des Wassers.
Besonders schön ist die entspannte Atmosphäre – man kann hier wirklich runterkommen, picknicken, die Aussicht genießen und einfach Zeit draußen verbringen. Preis-Leistung ist top und im Vergleich zu vielen anderen Attraktionen in Dubai ist es ein ruhiger, natürlicher Ort mit viel Raum zum Durchatmen.
textTranslated:
Creek Park in Dubai is a truly beautiful green oasis in the heart of the city. Perfect for families, walks, bike rides, or simply escaping the hustle and bustle. The park is very spacious, well-maintained, and offers plenty of shady spots, large lawns, playgrounds for children, and lovely paths along the water.

The relaxed atmosphere is particularly appealing – you can really unwind, have a picnic, enjoy the view, and simply spend time outdoors. It offers excellent value for money and, compared to many other attractions in Dubai, is a tranquil, natural place with plenty of space to breathe.

text:
تحتوي الحديقة على مسطحات واشجار وممرات وبحيرة ومسبح للعروض الدلافين
مكان هادئ وجميل ويمكن الشوي به
textTranslated:
The park features lawns, trees, walkways, a lake, and a dolphin show pool.

It's a quiet and beautiful place, and barbecue facilities are available.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Ahara So
text:
الحديقة رائعة من كل شيء خدمات مرافق أجواء. لكن لو أمكن ان تمنع لعب الكرة لقد افسدت علينا طاولةالطعام وللأسف كومار الاب وابنه ،هو من ركلها تجاهنا أكثر من مرة حتى ذهبت وتحدثت  اليه بالتوقف أو سأبلغ إدارة الحديقة.
غير معقول تصرفه.
The park is wonderful in every way: services, facilities, atmosphere. But if possible, please stop people from playing football. They ruined our picnic table, and unfortunately, Kumar and his son kicked it towards us more than once, until I went and told him to stop or I would report him to the park management.
His behaviour was unacceptable.
textTranslated:
The park is wonderful in every way: services, facilities, and atmosphere. But if possible, please stop people from playing football. They ruined our picnic table, and unfortunately, Kumar and his son kicked the ball towards us more than once, until I went and told them to stop or I would report them to the park management.

Their behavior was unacceptable.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

text: مكان مناسب جدا للنزهات بالنسبه للعوائل وفيه مركز للعلوم وتثقيف الاطفال والمكان واسع جدا ويحتوي الكثير من اللعاب الاطفال ارجوحات وغيرها ويمتد للساحل الخور وكورنيش جميل وطبيعي رائع كل شيئ منسق وجميل انصح به جدا للعوائل
textTranslated: A very suitable place for family outings, it includes a science and children's education center. The place is very spacious and contains many children's games, swings, and more. It extends to the creek and a beautiful, natural corniche. Everything is well-organized and lovely. I highly recommend it for families.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

textTranslated: One of the distinctive parks that includes a cable car, play areas, green spaces, and a children's city, which is an entertainment and educational city where you can spend enjoyable and useful times as well.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

textTranslated: A beautiful winter park located on Dubai Creek, featuring a dolphin show pool and daily events.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Anas Akour
text:
الحديقة رائعة،، واسعة ومخدومة بشكل جيد،،
الحديقة مطلة على خور دبي،،
الدخول للحديقة بالبطاقة (بطاقة نول) وهي نفس البطاقة المستخدمة للمواصلات،، رسم الدخول 5 دراهم للشخص،،
الحديقة تكون مزدحمة جدا في العطلات والاجازات لدرجة أنه من الصعوبة ايجاد مصف للسيارة في مصفات الجديقة،، فتضطر للاصطفاف بعيدا ثم المشي للحديقة،،
وأيضا للذين لا يحملون بطاقة نول فانك تضطر للوقوف في طابور طويل لشراء البطاقة،،

تجربة ممتازة،،
textTranslated:
The park is wonderful, spacious, and well-maintained.
The park overlooks Dubai Creek.
Entrance to the park is by card (Nol card), the same card used for public transportation. The entrance fee is 5 dirhams per person.
The park gets very crowded during holidays and vacations, to the point that it's difficult to find a parking space in the park parking areas. You have to park far away and then walk to the park.
Also, for those without a Nol card, you have to stand in a long line to purchase the card.

An excellent experience.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Ahmed Yassen
text:
حديقه ضخمه تطل ع خور دبي
بها منطقه اللعاب للاطفال
ليست مجانيه هناك رسوم للدخول
اماكن مخصصه للشواء
الباركن محدود
رجاء الحذر يتم مخالفه السيارات خارج نطاق المنطقه المخصصه لركن السيارات
textTranslated:
A huge park overlooking Dubai Creek
Features a children's play area
Entry is not free; there is an entrance fee
Designated barbecue areas are available
Parking is limited
Please be careful; vehicles parked outside the designated parking area will be ticketed
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

text:
Парк понравился, хорошее место для отдыха. Очень расстроило отсутствие канатной дороги, а так хотелось прокатиться над парком.
Кто планирует заехать в парк на канатную дорогу прокатиться, знайте- её больше нет.
textTranslated:
I liked the park; it's a nice place to relax. I was very disappointed by the lack of a cable car; I really wanted to take a ride above the park.
Anyone planning to take the cable car into the park should know that it's no longer there.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

text:
Schöner und großer Park am Creek. 5 DHS Eintritt.
Saubere Toiletten.
Viele Vögel im Park und am Ufer. Den Park sollte man wegen der Natur besuchen. Die Attraktionen sind teilweise geschlossen und die Installationen etwas in die Jahre gekommen.
textTranslated:
Beautiful and large park on the creek. 5 DHS entrance fee.

Clean restrooms.

Many birds in the park and along the banks. The park is worth visiting for its natural beauty. Some attractions are closed, and the facilities are somewhat dated.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

text: المكان جميل جدا، لكن في سلبية هي عدم توفر عربات كافية لنقل أمتعة الناس لداخل الحديقة حتى لو بأجر مدفوع، وهذا يجعل الشخص لا يفكر بالذهاب إليها مرة أخرى.
textTranslated: The place is very beautiful, but the downside is the lack of sufficient carts to transport people's luggage into the park, even if paid, and this makes a person not think about going there again.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

textTranslated: Enjoyable for strolling and having a barbecue

name: Naji Saleh
text:
حديقة جميلة ورائعة ومميزة . موقع مميز على خور دبي تضم عدة مرافق للترفيه للكبار والصغار.
المرافق والخدمات:

مدينة الطفل،مركز الدلافيين،خدمات المرافق العامة (دورات مياه)،مصليات،مسرح الحديقة، حديقة الزهور،الحديقة الصحراوية،خدمات المطاعم و المقاصف،خدمات مناطق ألعاب الأطفال (مهيأة لاستخدام أصحاب الهمم)،خدمات تأجير الدراجات الهوائية، خدمة ركوب القطار،
مساحة شاسعة مرتبة ونظيفة .مسطحات خضراء واشجار كبيرة وصغيرة .اماكن مخصصة للشواء ومجهزة بمقاعد ومظلات .مكان رائع لقضاء الوقت مع العائلة والأصدقاء،تعد الأحدث تجهيزا والأكثر تميزا بموقعها الإستراتيجي القريب من وسط المدينة .
مواقف مجانية للزوار، رسم الدخول 5دراهم للفرد
textTranslated:
A beautiful, magnificent, and distinctive park. A prime location on Dubai Creek, it offers a variety of recreational facilities for adults and children.

Facilities and Services:

Children's City, Dolphin Center, Public Restrooms, Prayer Rooms, Park Amphitheater, Flower Garden, Desert Garden, Restaurants and Cafeterias, Children's Play Areas (accessible to people with disabilities), Bicycle Rental, Train Ride.

A vast, well-maintained, and clean area. Green spaces and trees of all sizes. Designated barbecue areas equipped with seating and umbrellas. A wonderful place to spend time with family and friends. It is the newest and most distinguished park, strategically located near the city center.

Free parking for visitors. Entrance fee: 5 dirhams per person.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Kristena Abd elmaseh
text:
المكان جميل جدا.  بس منطقة الأطفال مغلقة من 2 الي 4 سنين

تعبت جدا مع بنتي الصغيرة طول الوقت مش عارفة اشغلها ف ايه و اخواتها الكبار انبسطوا جدا
textTranslated:
The place is very beautiful. However, the children's area is closed for ages 2 to 4.

I was so tired of my little girl; I didn't know what to do with her all the time, while her older siblings had a great time.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

text: حديقة جميلة لقضاء الوقت والتنزه ومشاهدة الخور (رايقة)

address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Quentin Palmaerts
text: Beau parc pour se promener. Il y a plusieurs pleines de jeux pour les enfants ainsi que d'innombrables points pour pique-niquer et faire des BBQ. Le Dolphinarium est localisé également dans le parc.
textTranslated: A lovely park for a stroll. There are several playgrounds for children, as well as countless spots for picnics and barbecues. The Dolphinarium is also located within the park.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Amira Abdelmageed
text: حديقه على مساحة كبيره ممتعه لكن تحتاج لزيادة عدد الالعاب وصيانتها لان عددها لا يتناسب مع الازدحام تمتاز بوجود جزء من البحر بها وهذا ممتع جدا بالنسبه لى ويميزها عن باقى الحدائق
textTranslated: The park is large and enjoyable, but it needs more play equipment and maintenance because the current number isn't enough for the crowds. It has a section of the sea, which is very enjoyable for me and distinguishes it from other parks.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Umed Abidov
text: Очень большой парк. Не дорогой вход. Есть возможность взять на прокат велосипеды как семейные так и отдельные в виде машинок. Есть детские площадки и продажа разного фастфуда. Неплохое место для отдыха с семьей с ноября по март
textTranslated: A very large park. Admission is inexpensive. Family bikes and individual bikes are available for rent. There are playgrounds and various fast food outlets. A good place for a family vacation from November to March.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Ahmed Elsayed
text:
مكان رائع وجميل لجميع  العائلة، لكن بخصوص مواقف السيارات تحتاج بعض التنظيم خصوصا بوابة رقم واحد لأنها قريبة من مدينة الطفل وليس كل زوار الحديقة سوف يزورن مدينة الطفل بناء عليه من الممكن جعل مواقف بوابة واحد خاصة بزوار حديقة الطفل وكبار السن وأصحاب الهمم، انا اخر زيارة لي كان معايا كبار سن واطفال ولم أجد موقف الا بوابة 4 واضريت امشي لغاية مدينة الطفل، مما أدى الي تعب المرافقين من كبار سن واطفال.
شكرا لكم
textTranslated: A wonderful and beautiful place for the whole family, but regarding parking, some organization is needed, especially Gate 1, because it is close to the Children's City, and not all visitors to the park will visit the Children's City. Therefore, it is possible to make the parking spaces at Gate 1 special for visitors to the Children's City, the elderly, and people of determination. On my last visit, I was with elderly people and children, and I did not find a parking space except Gate 4, and I had to walk to the Children's City, which led to fatigue for the accompanying elderly and children. Thank you.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: عبدالله بن صالح الدريعي
text: حديقة جميلة ورائعة ، وفيها متعة حقيقية للاطفال . تطل على خور دبي ؛ ومنه اشتق أسمها ( حديقة الخور ) زرتها قبل 19سنة ، فيها جلسات رائعة تطل على ماء خور دبي ، فيها تقدم الماكولات ااشهية ؛ كوجبات خفيفة . وفيها مسرح كبير . وفي الوقت الذي زرت الحديقة كان يعرض على مسرح الحديقة مسرحية ماوكلي فتى الادغال ، قام بعرضها مجموعة من الاطفال الهنود ؛ الذين يلبسون لباس الحيوانات التي ظهرت في عرض الرسوم المتحركة الشهير ( ماوكلي ) على قناة سبيستون للاطفال . واذكر شاهدنا فيها الممثل السوري الشهير ناجي جبر ( ابو عنتر ) بكامل لباسه الذي يرتديه في مسلسل صح النوم . وكان يجلس في إحدى عربات القطار الذي يسير ؛ ويلتف حول الحديقة .
textTranslated: A beautiful and wonderful park, a true delight for children. It overlooks Dubai Creek, from which it derives its name (Cream Park). I visited it 19 years ago. It has wonderful seating areas overlooking the waters of Dubai Creek, and delicious snacks are served there. It also has a large theater. At the time of my visit, the park's theater was showing a play about Mowgli, the Jungle Boy, performed by a group of Indian children dressed as the animals from the famous animated series (Mowgli) on Spacetoon children's channel. I remember seeing the famous Syrian actor Naji Jabr (Abu Antar) there, in his full costume from the series "Sah Al Noum." He was sitting in one of the train cars that circled the park.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Paul Lee
text: 공원에서 양갈비 구어먹고 분위기가 너무 좋았음
textTranslated: I had grilled lamb ribs at the park and the atmosphere was great.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Dzmitry Piatrovich
text: Для местных жителей это райский уголок, здесь красивый вид, но мало развлечений. От метро добраться можно на такси за 12 местных. И там за вход первый раз вдвоем + ребенок заплатили 25 дерхам. Уголок в котором стоит отметиться.
textTranslated: For locals, this is a paradise, with a beautiful view but little in the way of entertainment. A taxi from the metro costs 12 locals. And the first entrance fee for two people plus a child was 25 dirhams. It's definitely worth checking out.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Mashhor Mosaed
text: مكان مناسب للعائلة. يحتوي على مسطحات خضراء، شاطئ، قاعة عروض الدلافين والطيور لكل منهما رسم دخول، منطقة خاصة مغلقة لألعاب الأطفال، قطار، العاب مكشوفه، كشكات وجبات خفيفة وعصائر ومرطبات. الدخول بخمسة دراهم، وقد يختلف السعر بحسب الموسم. مواقف محيطة بالحديقة (الوقوف بالخارج).
textTranslated: A family-friendly place. It features green spaces, a beach, a dolphin and bird show (each with an entrance fee), a private enclosed children's play area, a train, outdoor play areas, and kiosks selling snacks, juices, and refreshments. Entry is five dirhams, but the price may vary depending on the season. Parking is available around the park (outside parking).
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: حووور المرزوقي
text: جميلة وهادئة ومرتبة ولها ذكريات رائعة وتلفريك متنزه وترفيه عائلي ممتاز ومطاعم وأماكن لتأجير الدراجات ومساحات واسعة وتقام فيها عروض للدلافين وبها مسرح الطفلزالجميل وغيرها من اطلالة عالخور .. تستحق الزيارة
textTranslated: Beautiful, peaceful, and well-organized, it holds wonderful memories. It features a cable car, an excellent family entertainment park, restaurants, bicycle rentals, spacious areas, dolphin shows, a lovely children's theater, and other amenities, including a view of the creek. It's well worth a visit.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: JLL
text: Es un parque agradable, si no fuera por el calor. Hay que pagar poco más de un euro para entrar.
textTranslated: It's a pleasant park, if it weren't for the heat. The entrance fee is just over one euro.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Dirk Schwarze
text: Riesiger Park und top gepflegt. Es gibt diverse "Zusatzattraktionen" die wir nicht genutzt haben. Wir wollten vom Park zu Fuß weiter in Richtung "Altstadt", stellten dann aber fest, dass uns der Weg zu weit war bzw. uns zu warm war.
textTranslated: A huge park, impeccably maintained. There are several "additional attractions" which we didn't use. We wanted to walk from the park towards the "old town", but then realized that the walk was too far and/or too hot for us.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: ياسمين الحميد
text: الدخول ببطاقة الحدائق الرسوم رمزية ومخفضة فيها مركز للطفل يفتح نهارا وكبيرة وفيها بحيرة
textTranslated: Entry with a park card; fees are symbolic and reduced. It includes a children's center open during the day, and it is large with a lake.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Um Hibah Al Rahman
text: حديقة هادئة مطلة على خور دبي ، بها بعض الانشطة المناسبة للأطفال مثل عرض الدلافين الذي انصح بتجربته فقد كان ممتع للغاية ، كما يوجد بها ينة الطفل التي تحتوي على بعض الانشطة التعليمية والترفيهية هي اشبه بمتحف تعليمي
textTranslated: A tranquil park overlooking Dubai Creek, it offers some activities suitable for children, such as the dolphin show, which I highly recommend as it was very enjoyable. It also features a children's park with educational and recreational activities, resembling an educational museum.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Rahaf Al Masri
text:
حديقه الخور مساحاتها الخضراء وتنوع اشجارها وطيورها روعه .. لكن العاب الاطفال فيها جدا صغيره ومحدوده فيها ركوب على الجمل والحصان الصغير ..
الدخول لها ب 5 ريال .. وكل نشاط داخلها تدفع له بشكل منفصل .. فيها مدينه الطفل وفيها عروض دولفين
textTranslated: Al Khor Park is wonderful, with its green spaces, diverse trees, and birds. However, the children's play area is very small and limited, offering only camel and pony rides. Entry costs 5 riyals, and each activity within the park requires a separate fee. There is a children's play area and dolphin shows.
address: Umm Hurair Second - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
title: Creek Park

name: Diego Martinez Romero
text: Al borde de una marina se encuentra este parque multitematico. Cuenta con playas con arena natural de poca extensión, lugar para hacer parrillas y muchos juegos infantiles. La tarjeta del metro es la que de utiliza como medio de pago (5 dirham por persona). Lindo paseo de no más de 2hs si es que no viene a almorzar o a pasar la tarde.
textTranslated: Located on the edge of a marina, this multi-themed park features small, natural sandy beaches, barbecue areas, and numerous children's play areas. It also has cafes and fast-food restaurants. Additionally, there's a dolphinarium, which requires a separate entrance fee. The metro card is accepted as payment (5 dirhams per person). It's a pleasant outing that should take no more than two hours unless you plan to have lunch or spend the afternoon there.
